mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(l.name, '未定级') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM doctor d LEFT JOIN doctor_level l ON l.id = d.level_id GROUP BY l.id, l.name ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT IFNULL(t.name, '未分科') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM doctor d LEFT JOIN treat_type t ON t.id = d.type_id GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT title, time, source FROM ( SELECT title, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time, '医保政策' AS source FROM medical_policy UNION ALL SELECT title, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time, '公司政策' AS source FROM company_policy UNION ALL SELECT title, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time, '必备材料' AS source FROM material ) t ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
